Captured epoch plus user ID/refresh/access tuple protects both async stages and normalization continuation. Logout or same-user replacement login aborts and invalidates old success/failure.

30second whole-session timer aborts and actively clears only the captured owner. Both refresh and /me late-success tests deliberately ignore cancellation and prove no token resurrection or readiness limbo.
